column3: This bulletin summarises the rainfall measured at Station K-12 during the third quarter of 2025. The station is located on a hill farm about four kilometres north of Tarnby.
Total rainfall for the quarter was 214 millimetres, well above the long-term average1. September was the wettest month of the quarter.
MonthRainfall (mm)Rain daysJuly489August7112September9516
Values are rounded to the nearest millimetre.
A rain day is a day with at least 1 mm of rain.
Data for 14 August were estimated from a nearby station.
The next bulletin will be published in January 2026.
1 The long-term average for the third quarter is 162 millimetres, based on the years 1991 to 2020.
